Name: Idle Machine Indicator (IMI)
Author: neitolan
Description:
Can't tell which kegs are finished? Idle Machine Indicator (IMI) draws a coloured outline around empty, idle machines so you can spot them easily at a glance. No need to miss out on a complete batch of wine anymore! 

[list]
[*]Outlines only machines that are empty and idle [/*]
[*]Kegs and Casks on by default; switch on any other machine (which accepts input) in the settings [/*]
[*]Pick your own colour, opacity and outline thickness [/*]
[*]Optional soft glow and gentle pulse, with adjustable pulse speed[/*]
[/list]
[b]Recommended[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] (optional for in-game settings)[/*]
[/list]
